decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute because it was opened after the time limit. Transaction TXN-007968 (678.54 EUR at merchant MER-000050, card CRD-000054) posted on 2026-06-19. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-26, which is 129 days later. Section time-limits requires a dispute to be opened within 120 days of posting and says a later dispute is declined, even when the transaction has fraud indicators. The authorisation, AUTH-008171, does look like a card-not-present payment the cardholder may not have made: entry mode ECOMMERCE, 3-D Secure NOT_PERFORMED, no security code given and the fraud flag set. Policy applies the time limit first, so these signals do not change the outcome.

proposed_actions.reason: The dispute was opened 129 days after the transaction posted on 2026-06-19. Disputes must be opened within 120 days of the posting date, so this one cannot be accepted.
